understanding.goal_understanding: Reach the goal gem tile marked + in each level, avoiding spike tiles; finish the current BP35 level and continue until the game is won.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: MOVE_LEFT and MOVE_RIGHT shift the player horizontally, while gravity pulls the player downward and can cause multi-tile falls. CLICK targets removable/clickable tiles; removing support can change the player's position or open a path, while clicking an irrelevant tile may only consume a turn. Landing on a spike ends the attempt and restarts the level, with two attempts and up to 50 turns per attempt. The recent actions did not demonstrate undo clearly, but repeated clicks on an already removed tile had no additional effect.
